name: Top of Gelkak's Key
summary: A giant foreststrider bears the Top of Gelkak's Key into the woods near Darkshore. The piece broke from a mechanical key that belongs to the shipwrecked gnome Gelkak Gyromast.

sections.title: A Shattered Mechanism
sections.body:
Threshadons struck Gelkak Gyromast's ship off Darkshore and dragged it beneath the waves. Gelkak washed ashore with the winding key for his mechanical first mate. The coastal rocks broke the key into three pieces.

Before the dizzy pirate could gather his wits, beasts scavenged the wreckage. A giant foreststrider carried the ornate upper piece into the woods.

sections.title: Restoring the First Mate
sections.body: Gelkak Gyromast needs the key to wind and activate his mechanical first mate. He means to use the construct against the local wildlife. Shore murlocs took the middle piece, and reef crawlers took the bottom one. With all three fragments, Gyromast can mend the key and bring his construct to life.

faq.q: What is the Top of Gelkak's Key used for?
aliases: use of top of gelkaks key
faq.answer: The Top of Gelkak's Key is one of three broken pieces Gelkak Gyromast needs to repair his mechanical winding key. Once assembled, the key can reactivate his mechanical first mate.

faq.q: How did a foreststrider get this piece of the key?
aliases: why do tallstriders have the key
faq.answer: When Gelkak was shipwrecked off Darkshore, the key broke against the rocks. Beasts scavenged the wreckage, and a giant foreststrider carried the upper brass piece into the woods northeast of the shore.

faq.q: Where are the other pieces of the key?
aliases: middle and bottom of gelkak key
faq.answer: Greymist murlocs near the shipwreck took the middle section. Crabs scouring the tideline carried off the bottom section.
Gelkak Gyromast is a gnome pirate marooned on Darkshore after threshadons wrecked his vessel. Stranded and furious, he plots revenge against the coastal creatures.

angles.text: The key winds and activates a clockwork automaton. Its sturdy design shows the ingenuity of gnome tinkers.
As a gnome, you may find a fellow gnome surviving a shipwreck through eccentricity and clockwork contraptions familiar and endearing.
